title: Development Services Department Industry Technology Working Group Meeting – May 14, 2026
description:
The Industry Technology Working Group is a collection of DSD staff and building industry experts from the San Diego area to review and provide input and recommendations on Information technology initiatives the department is considering to make its operations more efficient, provide cost savings and better serve San Diego’s customers and citizens.
